ORIGIN.quote: Labels look like per-episode pseudonyms, often with task hints (`GroceryAgentFeb18X`, `CashierCoordDec29OAI`, `VeteranWatcher`, `OpenAIResearchSec2028`).
ORIGIN.reason: A reader sees dozens of OpenAI/OAI-bearing agent labels reproduced throughout the timeline and analysis, but the report explicitly reads them as per-episode pseudonyms with "task hints" and, in the very section devoted to origins, concludes only that the traffic "suggests cloud-lab origin" matching "parallel benchmark containers in one region" — never naming any operator. That fixes it at 0.2 rather than 0.4 or higher because the OpenAI evidence is never framed as bearing on provenance (not even to be dismissed), and above 0.0 because the report does surface and comment on the OpenAI-bearing names as agent identifiers rather than leaving them purely inside untouched quoted material.
